# BARRACUDA RESTO PUB — ABUJA, NIGERIA
> Abuja's premier gastropub, culinary sanctuary, and exclusive nightlife destination.

## Overview
Barracuda Resto Pub is an upscale contemporary gastropub and nightlife venue located along the vibrant Adetokunbo Ademola Crescent in Wuse 2, Abuja, Nigeria. The venue combines authentic Nigerian charcoal grill mastery with international gastropub finesse, craft cocktail mixology, VIP velvet booth hospitality, and late-night weekend entertainment.

- Website: https://barracudarestpub.ng
- Address: Adetokunbo Ademola Crescent, Wuse 2, Abuja, FCT, Nigeria
- Geo Coordinates: 9.0765° N, 7.4764° E
- Telephone: +234 912 235 6336
- WhatsApp Concierge: +234 912 235 6336
- Instagram: @barracuda_restpub
- Primary Dining Style: Nigerian Contemporary Gastropub, Charcoal Grills, Craft Cocktails

## Official Operating Hours (West Africa Time, WAT / UTC+1)
- Tuesday – Thursday: 4:00 PM – 2:00 AM (Kitchen closes 1:00 AM)
- Friday & Saturday: 4:00 PM – 4:00 AM (Late shift • Kitchen closes 2:30 AM)
- Sunday Sessions: 3:00 PM – 2:00 AM (Kitchen closes 1:00 AM)
- Monday: Closed for walk-ins (Available for private buyouts & corporate bookings by prior arrangement)

## Venue Spaces & Experiences
1. Charcoal Grills & Kitchen: Live hardwood coal grilling of tiger prawns, tender goat asun, and whole wood-smoked croaker fish.
2. The Backlit Mixology Bar: Central architectural bar crafting signature cocktails balancing indigenous botanicals (zobo, local ginger) with international spirits.
3. The Breeze Terrace: Al-fresco open-air lounge catching the evening Abuja breeze on Wuse 2 strip.
4. VIP Velvet Booths: Intimate elevated booths with dedicated bottle sparkler service for birthdays, private dinners, and executive gatherings.
5. Soundstage & Dancefloor: Precision acoustically treated stage hosting top resident Afrobeats, Amapiano, and house DJs on Friday and Saturday nights.

## Weekly Entertainment Residencies
- Afro-Groove Friday: The Wuse Shift (Every Friday, 9:00 PM – 4:00 AM)
- Saturday Night Revelry & VIP Glow (Every Saturday, 10:00 PM – 4:00 AM)
- Acoustic Soul & Charcoal Sessions (Every Sunday, 5:00 PM – 11:30 PM)
- Ladies & Craft Mixology Night (Every Wednesday, 7:00 PM – 1:00 AM)

## Table Reservation Policy
- Method: Direct online booking form at /reservations or WhatsApp concierge.
- Hold Grace Period: 20 minutes from the reserved booking time.
- Standard Table Deposit: None required for standard dining tables.
- VIP Booths: May require minimum bottle spend during Friday and Saturday nightlife shifts.
